name: 融合检索
description: Semantic baseline tools for the remote Fusion Search service, with built-in token acquisition and refresh.

agentTools.name: fusion_semantic_baseline
agentTools.description: Manage the remote semantic baseline used by Fusion Search ranking. Use action=prepare to create a baseline from an application number or text and receive Chinese and English terms; action=get_terms to read every active term and weight; action=update_terms to replace one or both complete language lists and persist weights. Authentication is fully automatic; credentials are configured in the plugin data directory, never in tool arguments.

action.description: prepare=create a baseline; get_terms=read terms and weights; update_terms=save complete replacement lists.

reference.description: The application number or technical text used by prepare.

reference_kind.description: The prepare input mode. Specify application_number for an application number and text for direct text input.

element_id.description: The element_id returned by prepare, required by get_terms and update_terms.

chinese.description: The complete desired Chinese term list. Omit to preserve the current Chinese list.

english.description: The complete desired English term list. Omit to preserve the current English list.

verify.description: Read the saved terms again after update_terms. Defaults to true.
